title: User Authentication - Successful Login
description: Verify that users can log in successfully with valid credentials and receive appropriate session data including roles.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input valid username and password
Submit login form
Verify that login is successful and session data is returned with user role

title: User Authentication - Failed Login
description: Verify that the system correctly denies access when incorrect credentials are provided.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input invalid username or password
Submit login form
Verify that login fails with an appropriate error message

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Validate that users with different roles have access only to their permitted data and actions.

steps.description: Login as a user with limited role
Attempt to access data or perform actions restricted to admin
Confirm access is denied with security error
Login as an admin user
Access restricted admin features
Confirm access is granted to admin features

title: Create Shipment with Valid Data
description: Verify that a shipment can be created with valid origin, destination, and transport mode and that ETA is calculated correctly.

steps.description: Login as Admin or Manager
Navigate to create shipment page
Enter valid origin, destination, and transport mode
Submit shipment creation
Verify shipment is created with correct status and a proper ETA is returned

title: Create Shipment with Missing Required Fields
description: Test shipment creation fails when required fields such as origin or destination are missing.

steps.description: Login as Admin or Manager
Attempt to create shipment without origin
Verify that shipment creation is rejected with validation error
Attempt to create shipment without destination
Verify that shipment creation is rejected with validation error

title: Shipment Status Update and Tracking
description: Ensure shipment status can be updated and tracked successfully including updates to progress and ETA.

steps.description: Create and access existing shipment
Update shipment status to 'In Transit'
Verify status is updated correctly and progress percentage reflects the shipment lifecycle
Fetch shipment ETA via API
Verify ETA is current and reflects expected delivery date

title: Generate GST-Compliant Invoice
description: Validate invoice creation with correct GST calculations, linkage to shipment, and generation of PDF with company branding.

steps.description: Login as Finance or Manager
Create invoice linked to an existing shipment with freight amount and GST percentage
Verify the invoice is created successfully with accurate GST tax fields
Generate invoice PDF
Ensure PDF is generated correctly and contains company branding and accurate invoice data

title: Send Invoice via WhatsApp and SMS
description: Verify that invoices can be sent through WhatsApp and SMS channels successfully with message ID and delivery confirmation.

steps.description: Login as Finance or Manager
Select existing invoice and send via WhatsApp
Verify successful message send with valid messageId and recipient number
Send invoice notification via SMS
Confirm SMS sent successfully

title: Barcode Generation Validity - GS1 and Internal Formats
description: Ensure barcode generation supports GS1-compliant SSCC-18, GTIN-14, and TAC-specific barcode formats; validate output correctness.

steps.description: Request generation of SSCC-18 barcode with valid company prefix and shipment ID
Validate barcode conforms to GS1 SSCC-18 specifications
Request generation of GTIN-14 barcode
Validate barcode conforms to GS1 GTIN-14 format
Generate TAC internal barcode with shipment ID
Verify barcode matches internal format and is uniquely assigned

title: Record Package Scan Event
description: Verify that package scan events can be recorded including barcode, scan type, location, and operator ID, and reflect real-time package movement.

steps.description: Submit scan event with valid barcode, scan type (e.g., 'received'), location, and operator ID
Confirm scan event is recorded and timestamped
Retrieve shipment tracking timeline via API
Validate scan event appears correctly in shipment progress timeline

title: Inventory Stock Adjustment and Low Stock Alert
description: Test real-time inventory updates including inbound, outbound, and cycle count adjustments triggering low stock alerts with accurate stock and location data.

steps.description: Adjust inventory via API using 'inbound' adjustment with SKU, quantity, and location
Verify inventory stock for SKU is incremented and location updated
Perform 'outbound' adjustment reducing stock
Confirm stock decremented accordingly
Reduce stock below predefined low stock threshold
Verify low stock alert is triggered and visible to user

title: Create and Update Air Cargo Manifest
description: Validate that manifests can be created and updated grouping shipments by origin and destination, including airline code, flight number and manifest date.

steps.description: Create manifest with origin_hub, destination, airline_code, flight_number, and manifest_date
Verify manifest is created and contains the provided details
Update manifest details with changes to flight number or date
Confirm manifest is updated and changes are reflected

title: Customer Details Update
description: Verify that customer contact, GST information, and credit limits can be updated successfully.

steps.description: Login as authorized user
Update customer record with new phone, email, address, city, and GST number
Confirm customer details are saved and retrievable with updated values

title: Financial Reporting - Accounts Receivable Summary and Aging
description: Ensure financial reports correctly display outstanding invoices with accuracy in aging classifications for current, 30, 60, and 90+ days overdue.

steps.description: Access Accounts Receivable summary report as Finance user
Verify totals for outstanding balance, current, overdue 30, overdue 60, and overdue 90 match invoice and payment data
Add payment against an invoice
Confirm AR summary updates to reflect payment accordingly

title: Public Shipment Tracking Without Authentication
description: Validate that external customers can search shipments by shipment reference, invoice reference, or barcode without login and receive correct shipment status and timeline.

steps.description: Submit public tracking query using shipment reference
Verify shipment details and timeline are returned correctly with 'found' true
Submit public tracking query using invoice reference
Verify shipment details and timeline are returned correctly
Submit public tracking query using barcode number
Confirm correct shipment info is returned
Submit public tracking query with invalid or nonexistent reference
Verify response indicates shipment not found

title: API Performance Under Normal and Peak Load
description: Ensure all APIs respond within 500ms under normal and simulated peak loads of 100+ concurrent users with proper rate limiting.

steps.description: Simulate 100+ concurrent users making typical API requests including shipment, invoice, and inventory endpoints
Verify response times are below 500ms for all requests
Send rapid repeated requests exceeding rate limits
Confirm rate limiting responses are issued preventing abuse

title: System Uptime and Error Monitoring
description: Validate that system uptime meets 99.9% target and errors are tracked accurately by Sentry with performance analytics available via Vercel Analytics.

steps.description: Review system uptime logs over a defined period
Verify uptime is at or above 99.9%
Induce known application errors to trigger Sentry logging
Confirm errors are logged and visible in Sentry dashboard
Access performance dashboards on Vercel Analytics
Verify response times and page load metrics are reported

title: Invoice Payment Recording
description: Ensure payments can be recorded correctly against invoices including amount, payment mode, and reference details updating invoice payment status.

steps.description: Record payment by submitting invoice_id, amount, payment_mode, and reference
Verify payment is saved and invoice outstanding balance is updated accordingly
Attempt to record payment exceeding invoice outstanding amount
Confirm validation error is returned

title: Global Search Functionality
description: Test global search across shipments, invoices, and customers returns relevant results filtered by query string and type parameter.

steps.description: Perform global search with a query string targeting shipment references
Verify shipment results are returned matching query
Perform search filtering by invoice
Confirm invoice results are accurate
Search filtered by customers
Ensure customer matches are listed
